svg.title: The KV-head axis gets smaller
svg.desc: Equal-size cells compare KV caches at T=4. Each KV head has four rows, p0 through p3, with two key and two value components each. MHA has four heads and 64 components; GQA two heads and 32; MQA one head and 16.
svg.text: One layer · T = 4 · Two components per head
